verdict.rationale: Mem0 supports memory updates (docs-2) and manual expiration_date fields that stop surfacing outdated memories once a set date passes (mem0-docs-11, mem0-docs-19, mem0-docs-37), which gives a coarse current-vs-expired distinction, but there is no documented automatic temporal reasoning (e.g., valid_at/invalid_at timestamps, contradiction detection, or graph-edge temporal versioning) that tracks when a fact became true or was superseded. Missing for 10: explicit bi-temporal or valid-from/valid-to fact tracking, automatic detection/resolution of conflicting facts over time, and any graph-memory documentation showing temporal edges rather than just entity relations.
